knowledge_snippets.headline: RevPAR measures revenue spread across all available rooms, making it different from average daily rate.
tags: subdomain_description:Covers hospitality booking analytics for hotel properties, including revenue, length of stay, booking channels, property performance, brands, regions, and time-based trends.
domain_description:Sub-domains with no audience-window activity signal.
knowledge_snippets.content: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) is computed as `SUM(fb.total_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(fb.rooms_available), 0)`. The numerator is total booking revenue and the denominator is total available rooms over the same scope, such as region or period. This differs from ADR: RevPAR divides by all available rooms, while ADR divides by occupied room nights, so RevPAR is normally lower when occupancy is below 100%.

knowledge_snippets.headline: Year-over-year brand growth compares each brand’s annual revenue against that same brand’s previous year.
tags: subdomain_description:Covers hospitality booking analytics for hotel properties, including revenue, length of stay, booking channels, property performance, brands, regions, and time-based trends.
domain_description:Sub-domains with no audience-window activity signal.
knowledge_snippets.content: Year-over-year revenue growth by brand groups revenue at the `p.brand` by `d.year` grain, computes current revenue as `SUM(fb.total_revenue)`, and compares it to the prior year within the same brand using `LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)`. The growth rate is `(SUM(fb.total_revenue) - LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)) / LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)`. Join `fact_bookings` to `dim_property` for brand and to `dim_date` for year; the denominator is the previous year's revenue for the same brand, not the previous row across all brands.

knowledge_snippets.headline: RevPAR measures revenue spread across all available rooms, making it different from average daily rate.
tags: subdomain_description:Covers hospitality booking analytics for hotel properties, including revenue, length of stay, booking channels, property performance, brands, regions, and time-based trends.

knowledge_snippets.content: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) is computed as `SUM(fb.total_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(fb.rooms_available), 0)`. The numerator is total booking revenue and the denominator is total available rooms over the same scope, such as region or period. This differs from ADR: RevPAR divides by all available rooms, while ADR divides by occupied room nights, so RevPAR is normally lower when occupancy is below 100%.

knowledge_snippets.content: Year-over-year revenue growth by brand groups revenue at the `p.brand` by `d.year` grain, computes current revenue as `SUM(fb.total_revenue)`, and compares it to the prior year within the same brand using `LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)`. The growth rate is `(SUM(fb.total_revenue) - LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)) / LAG(SUM(fb.total_revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand ORDER BY d.year)`. Join `fact_bookings` to `dim_property` for brand and to `dim_date` for year; the denominator is the previous year's revenue for the same brand, not the previous row across all brands.
